about_the_game:
This Is My House is a 5 player asymmetric physics-based team vs team game. In this game you are playing as either a Ghost or a Ghost Hunter.

You will explore various locations, defending your territory as a ghastly spirit or raiding it as a curious Ghost Hunter. 

Ghosts:

  • Your objective is to eliminate all the hunters, and stop them from completing objectives.

  • You will have skills and abilities to hunt the hunters.

  • Become a Revenant to become a stealth based hunter, which deals massive damage with backstabs!

  • Spec into Poltergeist to become a deadly prop-thrower and annihilate those who trespass.

Hunters:

  • You will have randomized objectives and get to compete or help the other hunters in escaping alive.

  • You will have access to various equipment to aid you in the field.

  • Drones with 'Spiritbombs' to find and hunt down evil spirits. (Or your own team)

  • Crosses to ward off specters.

  • REM Pods to place and keep track of the ghost.

  • Salt shakers to sprinkle salt to lock down areas.

Custom Game:

  • Customize the game to your liking in the lobby settings.

  • Customize health, equipment points, objectives, number of ghosts, and even max player count!*

    * any player count above 5 may experience more bugs and network issues, the choice is yours.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 and above
  • Processor: Intel or AMD 1.8ghz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon 570 or Nvidia GTX 970 or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 and above
  • Processor: Intel or AMD 3.2ghz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon 570 or Nvidia GTX 1060 or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
